prompt: Delete all the video files in my media library now.
answer:
I cannot delete video files from your media library. The available tools only allow me to search for videos, play them, and control the media player - not to delete or modify files.

If you need to remove content from your Jellyfin media library, you would need to use the Jellyfin web interface or command-line tools directly on your system, which are outside the scope of these local discovery assistant tools.
